 UConn men’s basketball faces Wagner in home opener 
 Huskies maintain spot in AP Poll 
 By Rob Polansky Published : Nov. 9, 2026 at 7:41 AM EST | Updated : 2 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google STORRS, Conn. (WFSB) - The No. 4 UConn men’s basketball takes on Wagner on Monday night.
 The Huskies maintained their spot in the AP Top 25 College Basketball Poll .
 Florida, Duke, and Illinois rounded out the top three.
 Home opener in Storrs
 Tipoff from the M&T Bank Center at Gampel Pavilion is 7 p.m.
 WFSB will have a pregame show at 6:30 p.m. Look for it on WFSB+.
 HBO Max and truTV have the game broadcast.
 UConn defeated No. 16 Michigan at Boston’s TD Garden on Friday, 85-77.
 Braylon Mullins put up 23 points. Silas Demary Jr. added 21 of his own.
 The Huskies’ defense held the Wolverines to 25 percent shooting.
 Next, they host Ohio State at the PeoplesBank Arena in Hartford on Friday. Tip off is slated for 7:30 p.m.
